scripts.test:coverage: bun test tests/*.test.mjs tests/unit --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov && bun scripts/coverage-gate.ts
scripts.lint: bun --bun x oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json apps packages server scripts tests api --deny-warnings
scripts.format: bun --bun x oxfmt --write apps packages server scripts tests api
scripts.format:check: bun --bun x oxfmt --check apps packages server scripts tests api
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run check:syntax && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:coverage && bun run build && bun run build:type && bun run check:bundle && bun run check:styles && bun run check:security && bun run check:font
